ring.drawing_H_direction: Transverse width between the two entrance ends, parallel to D dimension, seen in actual front-view drawing.
ring.drawing_d_definition: Internal three-contact profile diameter, not shaft nominal outside diameter.

steel.designation: spring steel, no specific grade in this sheet

ring.stainless: spring stainless steel; this sheet does not specify a grade or stainless hardness

pin_comparison.meaning: Published recommended groove domains do not coincide; this prevents catalog-based direct interchange certification, not a proof of unavoidable physical assembly failure. The OCHIAI nominal shaft-range table also is not itself an express g6 HCDG part qualification.

installation.method: Radial insertion perpendicular to shaft axis, fully seated in its groove; maker ETH holder pairing exists.
manufacturer_cautions: Confirm both shaft and groove sizes
Do not reuse removed rings or use rings deformed by incorrect insertion
A large mating-part corner radius/chamfer can change load application; maker recommends a sufficiently rigid square-edged spacer in that case
not_proven: Installed maximum all-angle radius from shaft center
Full tool approach/removal channel in this launcher
Permissible application load with current mating materials
